lyrics:
[Intro: upright bass line alone, then triangle and a scraped gourd]

[Verse 1: warm, soulful, bass and light percussion]
Let the power go out all down the street
Let the phones go quiet in our hands
I'm alright, I'm alright
Long as you stay where I can see you

[Chorus: strings enter, voice opens]
So stay, stay
Stay where I can see you
Oh, stay
Stay where I can see you

[Verse 2: warm, a little stronger, strings underneath]
Let the river come up over the road
Let the wind take the shingles one by one
I'll be fine, I'll be fine
Long as you stay where I can see you

[Chorus: strings fuller, backing voices hum]
So stay, stay
Stay where I can see you
Oh, stay
Stay where I can see you

[String Break: strings play the melody over the bass line]

[Final Chorus: voice ad-libbing, strings and backing voices]
So stay, stay
Stay where I can see you
Whenever there's trouble, just stay
Stay where I can see you

[Outro: bass line alone again, triangle, fade]
